name: Wahl KM2 Professional 2-speed
description: Cut through the thickest coats with ease using the Wahl KM2 Professional 2-speed Clipper. Its two-speed design runs at a low speed of 3, 000 strokes-per-minute and a high speed of 3, 500 strokes-per-minute. Light and compact, these horse clippers come with a 16-foot cord, detachable blade with locking blade hinge, and a convenient snap on/off drive tip replacement. Details 2-Speed operation: Runs at a low speed of 3, 000 strokes-per-minute and a high speed of 3, 500 strokes-per-minute. Minimal vibration: Features a pivot gear system that minimizes vibration. Extra-long reach: Includes 16-foot power cord for easy maneuvering and access to power source. Additional features: Includes a detachable blade with locking blade hinge and a snap on/off drive tip replacement.
